card.title: KAWANISHI E7K
card.text: Reveal: Gets +2 attack if it is your turn.
card.flavorText: The Kawanishi E7K was a Japanese three-seat reconnaissance seaplane that was mainly used in the 1930s by the Imperial Japanese Navy. At the beginning of the Pacific War in 1941 it was mainly being used in second line duties. There were two variants: E7K1 with 183 built, and E7K2 with 350 built. The E7K2 variant was used in front line services up until 1943, and both versions were used during the final stages of the war for kamikaze operations. The E7K had a 3 man crew, an armament consisting of one Type 97 aircraft machine gun, two Type 92 machine guns and could carry up to 120 kg of bombs.
